subject: Security feature packaging & credits for pilot
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthbridge.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot scope / security add‑ons & commercial question

Priyom / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the latency profile looked solid and the KV cache behavior will help our clinical flows. Before we spin up a short pilot we need to align on a couple of purchasable items and how you intend to credit pilot costs back into a committed deal: audit log retention beyond 90 days, KMS/HSM seat pricing (we'll need two HSM seats for key escrow), and a temporary data residency overlay for our US-only pilot.

Can you provide a packaging option that:
- Lists discrete line items for Audit Logs (30/90/365 day tiers)
- Shows HSM seat pricing and an amortization option vs. monthly seat charge
- Explains residency surcharge (per-region multiplier or flat add-on)
- Outlines a pilot credit or one-time concession applied to the first invoice

I've attached a draft SOW to give context (HB_SOW_draft.pdf). Contracts may want the numbers to land before they issue a PO — CCing them on follow up.

Ideal timeline: finalize commercial by end of week, DocuSign by next Tue, kickoff 9/29.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of Platform & Security
HealthBridge.ai

Attachment: HB_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 124KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope / security add‑ons & commercial question

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for the SOW. High level options below; attaching a fee sheet with granular line items (redwood-compliance-fees-sheet.xlsx). Happy to iterate if you need alternate amortization.

Summary (US pilot):
- Audit logs: 30d = $0.00/mo (included), 90d = $1,200/mo, 365d = $5,000/mo (per account)
- KMS/HSM: HSM seat $4,500/month/seat; amortization option: one‑time setup fee $12,000 amortized across 12 months (equivalent $1,000/mo/seat)
- Residency overlay: US-only residency surcharge = 18% on base inference spend (applies to hosted/dedicated mix)
- Pilot credit: standard practice is a one-time pilot credit applied to the first invoice. We can offer up to 40% credit on recurring compliance line items for a 90‑day pilot, capped at $25k.

Two optional packaging paths:
A) Committed path (recommended if you expect to scale post-pilot): 12‑month commit with a blended discount on inference + compliance lines; we can include a $20k implementation credit for HSM amortization, and reduce the residency surcharge to 12% for the first 6 months.
B) Pilot-first path: month-to-month with pilot credits: 40% credit on Audit Logs and HSM line items for up to 90 days, residency surcharge at 18% during pilot. After pilot, standard rates apply unless you move to a commit.

Next steps I suggest: I can loop in Finance for a final review of the cap, and Marissa can confirm whether we can extend the HSM amortization concession to cover both seats fully. If OK, I'll send a redlined SOW and DocuSign link.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-compliance-fees-sheet.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: HealthBridge pilot credit ask — approval request

Folks — quick internal. HealthBridge wants a pilot concession (up to 40% credit on compliance lines) with two HSM seats and US residency overlay. My proposed commercial posture:
- Approve 40% credit on Audit Logs and HSM line items for up to 90 days, cap $25k total credit.
- Approve amortization of HSM setup fee across 6 months (instead of 12) for this strategic pilot so cashflow impact is front-loaded but recoverable.
- Keep residency surcharge at 18% during pilot but offer 12% for first 6 months if they commit to 12 months within 45 days post-pilot.

Rationale: HealthBridge is a product-led payer partner with large upside; this concession is bounded and incentivizes a commit. 

Ben — can you confirm the credit cap and cash impact? Jonas — legal will push for narrower windows; ok to limit credit window to 90 days? Marissa — you good to finalize SOW with these numbers if legal signs off?

On Wed, Sep 16, 2026 at 09:30 AM -07:00 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Priyom — credit cap $25k looks fine from revenue ops; amortizing over 6 months vs 12 increases near-term cash reduction but acceptable for strategic.
>
> Jonas — please flag any legal constraints.

Jonas replied (inline):
> +1 on 90d cap. Legal prefers an explicit clawback if they don’t convert within 45 days post-pilot (we should include language in SOW).

I'll proceed to send the finalized SOW to Elena once we get a brief legal note.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@healthbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, contracts@healthbridge.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot scope / security add‑ons & commercial question

Elena — thanks for the patience, and apologies for the back-and-forth. Below is the final commercial we can commit to for the US pilot (90 days):

Final pilot commercial (90 days):
- Audit logs: 90d retention — $1,200/mo (we will apply a 40% pilot credit for months 1–3; credit capped at $10,800 total)
- HSM seats: 2 seats at $4,500/mo/seat — amortization applied: one-time setup fee $12,000 amortized over 6 months (appears as $2,000/mo); plus $9,000/mo for seats. Redwood applies 40% credit to the recurring HSM line items for months 1–3; credit capped at $14,400 total.
- Residency overlay: 18% surcharge on inference during pilot. If HealthBridge signs a 12‑month commit within 45 days after pilot end, residency surcharge reduces to 12% for first 6 months post-commit.
- One-time implementation credit: $20,000 applied to the SOW on sign.
- Total pilot credit cap across all compliance lines: $25,000 (inclusive of the $20k implementation credit).

Attached is the redlined SOW and the fee sheet. If that aligns, please confirm and we will push a DocuSign envelope (link below) for signatures. Per legal, the SOW will include a simple clawback clause: credits are applied upfront and reimbursed pro-rata if no 12‑month commitment is executed within 45 days of pilot end.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/overview/abcdef123456
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/987654321

Proposed next steps:
1) Elena confirms commercial and signs SOW via DocuSign.
2) We schedule a 30‑minute kickoff (calendar invite after signature).
3) Implementation team to provision HSM keys and residency config (ETA 10 business days).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through line items.

Best,
Priyom Das
Director, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
priYom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555‑0199
